lines.zh: 圆顶龙迈着沉稳的大步
lines.en: Camarasaurus strides with steady weight.

lines.zh: 它的头低低地贴着灌木
lines.en: Its head rides low, close to the shrubs.

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后慢慢起伏
lines.en: Its tail rises and falls behind it.

lines.zh: 它一边走一边啃食蕨叶
lines.en: It grazes on ferns as it walks.

lines.zh: 脚掌落下，尘土轻轻一跳
lines.en: Dust hops lightly at each footfall.

lines.zh: 它从树荫走进阳光里
lines.en: It walks from the shade into the sun.

lines.zh: 短脖子探进叶丛深处
lines.en: Its short neck pushes into the leaves.

lines.zh: 它绕开一块突出的岩石
lines.en: It steps around a jutting rock.

lines.zh: 四足一起一落，节奏很慢
lines.en: Four feet rise and fall in slow rhythm.

lines.zh: 它走过的地方枝条都低了
lines.en: Branches bend where it has passed.

lines.zh: 它侧身挤过两株大树之间
lines.en: It squeezes between two tall trunks.

lines.zh: 蹄状的爪子陷进松土
lines.en: Its clawed feet sink into loose soil.

lines.zh: 它沿着兽径慢慢移动
lines.en: It moves along an old game trail.

lines.zh: 走到水边，它才停下来
lines.en: It halts only when it reaches water.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙站着咀嚼，声音很小
lines.en: Camarasaurus chews, making little sound.

lines.zh: 它抬起头，鼻孔轻轻开合
lines.en: It lifts its head and works its nostrils.

lines.zh: 阳光落在它拱起的背上
lines.en: Sunlight rests on its arched back.

lines.zh: 它眨眨眼，又垂下头
lines.en: It blinks and lowers its head again.

lines.zh: 它打了个带草味的响鼻
lines.en: It snorts, breath smelling of green.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖在地面上画了个弧
lines.en: Its tail tip draws an arc on the ground.

lines.zh: 它把体重慢慢挪到另一侧
lines.en: It shifts its weight slowly across.

lines.zh: 它安静得像一段倒下的树
lines.en: It is as quiet as a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 鸟在它脚边捡食小虫
lines.en: Birds peck for insects at its feet.

lines.zh: 它回头看了一眼林子
lines.en: It glances back into the trees.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出一声极轻的鸣
lines.en: A very soft call leaves its throat.

lines.zh: 它低头嗅了嗅自己的足迹
lines.en: It sniffs its own footprints.

lines.zh: 它把脖子搭在树干上休息
lines.en: It rests its neck against a trunk.

lines.zh: 它闭目片刻，耳朵仍动着
lines.en: It dozes, ears still moving.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙低头看你，眼神温和
lines.en: Camarasaurus looks down, calm-eyed.

lines.zh: 它把大脑袋凑到你面前
lines.en: It brings its big head close to you.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅你的衣服
lines.en: It sniffs your clothes.

lines.zh: 你对它来说太小了
lines.en: You are very small to it.

lines.zh: 它侧着头，认真打量你
lines.en: It tilts its head and studies you.

lines.zh: 它用鼻端碰了碰你的肩
lines.en: It touches your shoulder with its snout.

lines.zh: 它退开半步，让你过去
lines.en: It steps back to let you pass.

lines.zh: 它只是好奇，没有敌意
lines.en: Only curious, not hostile.

lines.zh: 它慢吞吞地眨眼
lines.en: It blinks very slowly.

lines.zh: 它把嘴里的叶子嚼完才看你
lines.en: It finishes its mouthful before looking.

lines.zh: 它哼了一声，像打个招呼
lines.en: It huffs, almost a greeting.

lines.zh: 它跟着你走了两步又停住
lines.en: It follows two steps and stops.

lines.zh: 它把下巴搁在低枝上瞅你
lines.en: It rests its chin on a branch and stares.

lines.zh: 你抬手，它低头配合
lines.en: You raise a hand; it lowers its head.

lines.zh: 它把影子让开一半给你
lines.en: It lets half its shade fall on you.

lines.zh: 它看你一会儿，转身吃草去了
lines.en: After a look, it turns back to grazing.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙吃痛，往旁边闪
lines.en: Camarasaurus lurches aside in pain.

lines.zh: 它低鸣一声，退开半步
lines.en: With a low note it gives ground.

lines.zh: 它回头看你，眼里有惊
lines.en: It looks back at you, startled.

lines.zh: 厚皮上留下一点血痕
lines.en: A thin blood line shows on its hide.

lines.zh: 它甩动尾巴，泄出怒气
lines.en: Its tail swings out in irritation.

lines.zh: 它把幼崽叫到身边
lines.en: It calls the calves to its side.

lines.zh: 它喘得很响，脚步乱了
lines.en: Breathing loudly, its steps go crooked.

lines.zh: 它不安地刨着地面
lines.en: It paws the ground uneasily.

lines.zh: 这点伤它忍得住，但记下了
lines.en: It can bear this, but it remembers.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转头，重新审视你
lines.en: It turns slowly and reassesses you.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙闻到嫩蕨的味道
lines.en: Camarasaurus smells young ferns.

lines.zh: 它慢慢朝你这边挪过来
lines.en: It ambles slowly in your direction.

lines.zh: 它伸长脖子够你手里的枝叶
lines.en: It stretches for the greens you hold.

lines.zh: 舌头一卷，枝条就没了
lines.en: One curl of tongue and the branch is gone.

lines.zh: 它用鼻尖轻轻拱你的手臂
lines.en: It nudges your arm with its snout.

lines.zh: 吃完它还站着不肯走
lines.en: Fed, it still will not leave.

lines.zh: 它低鸣着讨第二口
lines.en: It rumbles for a second helping.

lines.zh: 它把嘴凑得很近，很小心
lines.en: It brings its mouth close, very gently.

lines.zh: 它高兴得尾巴都摆起来了
lines.en: Its tail actually swings with pleasure.

lines.zh: 它一口气把灌木啃秃了
lines.en: It strips the shrub down to sticks.

lines.zh: 你撞在圆顶龙的胁腹上
lines.en: You bump into its flank.

lines.zh: 它被你碰得偏了半步
lines.en: The touch shifts it half a step.

lines.zh: 它侧过身，把你让出去
lines.en: It turns aside to let you through.

lines.zh: 它的腿擦过你的肩膀
lines.en: Its leg brushes past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它低头，怕踩到你
lines.en: It looks down, afraid to tread on you.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过，你差点跌倒
lines.en: Its tail sweeps by and you nearly fall.

lines.zh: 两头圆顶龙相撞，闷响很沉
lines.en: Two of them collide with a heavy thud.

lines.zh: 它把你挤到树干边上
lines.en: It crowds you against a trunk.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪开，让出路来
lines.en: It shifts away and opens the path.

lines.zh: 它扭头看你有没有事
lines.en: It turns its head to check on you.

lines.zh: 两头圆顶龙并肩啃同一丛蕨
lines.en: Two camarasaurs share one fern patch.

lines.zh: 它用头轻轻顶伴侣的颈
lines.en: It bumps its head gently on its mate's neck.

lines.zh: 低鸣一高一低，像在对答
lines.en: Two low calls rise and answer.

lines.zh: 它替伴侣拨开挡路的枝条
lines.en: It pushes a branch aside for its partner.

lines.zh: 它们缓慢地绕圈，脚步一致
lines.en: They circle slowly in matching steps.

lines.zh: 它把最好的嫩叶留给对方
lines.en: It saves the tenderest leaves for its mate.

lines.zh: 两只巨兽的尾巴几乎并在一起
lines.en: Their tails almost lie as one.

lines.zh: 它守在旁边，扫视四周
lines.en: It stands guard, scanning around.

lines.zh: 它们把头靠在一起很久
lines.en: They rest their heads together a long while.

lines.zh: 林间只剩下它们轻微的鼻息
lines.en: Only their soft breathing fills the wood.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙低头卷起地上的果实
lines.en: It curls its tongue around fallen fruit.

lines.zh: 它把枝叶含在嘴里慢慢嚼
lines.en: It holds the greens and chews slowly.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子把东西拱到你脚边
lines.en: It noses the item over to your feet.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅，觉得可以吃
lines.en: It sniffs and decides it is edible.

lines.zh: 它把食物推给身后的幼崽
lines.en: It pushes the food back to a calf.

lines.zh: 它叼着枝条，像叼一根草
lines.en: It carries the branch like a straw.

lines.zh: 它试着咬了一下，又放开
lines.en: It tests a bite, then lets go.

lines.zh: 它把落下的果子都拢过来
lines.en: It sweeps the fallen fruit together.

lines.zh: 吃完它舔了舔上颚
lines.en: After eating it licks its palate.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西理都不理
lines.en: What it dislikes, it simply ignores.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙忽然把身子转正
lines.en: Camarasaurus squares its body up.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙忽然把身子转正。
lines.en: The camarasaurus squares itself up.

lines.zh: 一声低鸣变得又长又硬
lines.en: Its low call turns long and hard.

lines.zh: 它前脚抬起，虚晃一下
lines.en: It lifts a foreleg in a feint.

lines.zh: 它的目光钉在了你身上
lines.en: Its gaze pins onto you.

lines.zh: 尾巴绷直，慢慢抬起
lines.en: Its tail stiffens and lifts.

lines.zh: 它不想打，但已经站稳
lines.en: It would rather not fight, but it is set.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸沉下来，变重了
lines.en: Its breathing deepens and grows heavy.

lines.zh: 它把路横着堵住
lines.en: It blocks the way broadside.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被它刨开一层
lines.en: Its feet scrape up the topsoil.

lines.zh: 它把你当成了靠近幼崽的威胁
lines.en: It counts you a threat to the calves.

lines.zh: 它侧头衡量你的高度
lines.en: It tilts its head, measuring your height.

lines.zh: 忽然安静下来，反而更吓人
lines.en: The sudden quiet is worse than noise.

lines.zh: 它往前迈了一步，地动了
lines.en: One step forward, and the ground moves.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙缓缓侧移，正对你
lines.en: It sidesteps slowly to face you.

lines.zh: 它用身体把空地占满
lines.en: It fills the clearing with its bulk.

lines.zh: 每一步都往你这边压
lines.en: Each step presses nearer to you.

lines.zh: 它低头试探，再抬头
lines.en: It dips its head, then lifts it.

lines.zh: 尾尖在地上不安地摆
lines.en: Its tail tip stirs restlessly.

lines.zh: 它时不时发出短促的鸣叫
lines.en: Short calls break from it now and then.

lines.zh: 它把退路一点点封掉
lines.en: It closes off your exits bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它不追，只等你靠近
lines.en: It does not chase; it waits you out.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛一直跟着你
lines.en: Its eyes never leave you.

lines.zh: 它挪动位置，始终护着幼崽
lines.en: It repositions, always guarding the calves.

lines.zh: 你绕，它也跟着转
lines.en: You circle; it turns with you.

lines.zh: 它低头啃了一口草，仍盯着你
lines.en: It takes a bite of grass, still watching.

lines.zh: 那份平静让人不敢靠近
lines.en: That calm is what keeps you back.

lines.zh: 它把前脚放在最有利的位置
lines.en: It plants its forefeet where they help most.

lines.zh: 只差一个动作，它就会冲
lines.en: One more move and it will charge.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙低头一顶，撞在胸口
lines.en: It ducks its head and rams your chest.

lines.zh: 它的前脚重重砸下
lines.en: A forefoot slams down hard.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，抽中你的侧面
lines.en: Its tail lashes across your side.

lines.zh: 它把你推得连退好几步
lines.en: It shoves you back several steps.

lines.zh: 肩膀一压，你几乎跪下
lines.en: A shoulder press nearly drops you.

lines.zh: 它咬空的牙齿碰得很响
lines.en: Its teeth clack shut on empty air.

lines.zh: 它用整个体重撞过来
lines.en: It drives its whole weight at you.

lines.zh: 它出手后立刻收住，没再追
lines.en: It strikes once and pulls back.

lines.zh: 地面被它跺出个浅坑
lines.en: It stamps a shallow pit in the dirt.

lines.zh: 这一下只是警告，不是杀招
lines.en: That was a warning, not a kill.

lines.zh: 它甩头，把你甩开半米
lines.en: A twist of its head throws you off.

lines.zh: 它的动作慢，重量却足
lines.en: Slow motion, enormous weight.

lines.zh: 尘土糊了你一脸
lines.en: Dust fills your face.

lines.zh: 它喘着气，退回幼崽前面
lines.en: Panting, it backs to the calves again.

lines.zh: 林子里传来沉重的脚步声
lines.en: Heavy footsteps come through the wood.

lines.zh: 圆顶龙从树影里走出来
lines.en: Camarasaurus walks out of the shade.

lines.zh: 先看到的是它拱起的背
lines.en: You see its arched back first.

lines.zh: 它撞开一丛高蕨，露出头
lines.en: It pushes through tall ferns and shows its head.

lines.zh: 一声低鸣，惊起一群鸟
lines.en: A low call startles a flock of birds.

lines.zh: 它的脚踩断了一根枯木
lines.en: Its foot snaps a dead log.

lines.zh: 它身后还跟着两只小的
lines.en: Two smaller ones follow behind it.

lines.zh: 它在空地中央停住，环顾四周
lines.en: It stops in the clearing and looks around.

lines.zh: 草叶上还挂着它带来的露水
lines.en: Dew from its passing still clings to the grass.

lines.zh: 它的影子把整片空地压暗
lines.en: Its shadow darkens the whole clearing.

lines.zh: 它低头啃了一口草，算是安顿
lines.en: It takes a bite of grass, settling in.

lines.zh: 这头巨兽走进了这片林子
lines.en: The giant has entered this wood.

lines.zh: 树枝被它顶得摇晃不停
lines.en: Branches sway where its head passed.

lines.zh: 它停在你几步外，慢慢呼气
lines.en: It stops a few paces off and breathes out.

lines.zh: 远处的兽径上出现了它的轮廓
lines.en: Its shape appears on the distant trail.

lines.zh: 它先是嗅了嗅，才迈步向前
lines.en: It sniffs first, then steps forward.

lines.zh: 阳光被切开一道长长的口子
lines.en: A long gap is cut through the sunlight.

lines.zh: 它把这片新地方当成家
lines.en: It treats this new place as home.

lines.zh: 皮毛被燎到，它踉跄着退开
lines.en: Singed fur sends it stumbling back.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，它的腿一弯
lines.en: Landing hard, its legs fold under it.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，它拼命仰头
lines.en: Water floods its nostrils; it strains upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把它推得侧滑出去
lines.en: The blast skids it sideways.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进它的肩肉
lines.en: An arrow buries in its shoulder.

lines.zh: 奇异的力量让它浑身一颤
lines.en: An odd force makes its whole body shudder.

lines.zh: 饿久了，它的肋骨显出来
lines.en: Hunger shows the line of its ribs.

lines.zh: 雷击让它四肢一麻，跪下去
lines.en: Lightning numbs its legs and it kneels.

lines.zh: 虚空拖住它，四蹄拼命蹬地
lines.en: The void drags; all four feet fight for grip.
